title: Introduction to Network Security
note: PDF is in Romanian; key topics inferred from headings
subtopics: application quality attributes: correctness, modularity, compatibility, security

definitions.definition: Ensuring information is accessible only to authorized entities
Ensuring information has not been tampered with
Ensuring services are accessible when needed
Denial of Service – attack overwhelming a service to make it unavailable
Distributed Denial of Service – DoS attack from many distributed sources
System that controls incoming/outgoing network traffic based on rules
Secure Sockets Layer / Transport Layer Security – cryptographic protocols for secure communication
Virtual Private Network – encrypted tunnel over a public network

learning_objectives: Identify common network vulnerabilities and attack types
Describe prevention mechanisms: firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, SSL/TLS
